one_liner: Corporate card and spend management platform for businesses, with an API for transactions, budgets, and expense data.

auth.evidence_quote: add it as a header to your API calls in the following format: Authorization: 'Bearer {{your user_token here}}'
auth.notes: Direct API access uses a long-lived Bearer token created from the Brex dashboard (per-account, admin-generated) rather than an 'API key' by name; Brex also documents OAuth2 for partner integrations acting on multiple customers' accounts (not directly confirmed this pass).

access.evidence_quote: Sign in to dashboard.brex.com as an account or card admin
access.notes: Any Brex customer's admin can self-serve generate a token; no separate paid tier or public sandbox found. 'Brex currently only offers a production API server' — no free/sandbox environment distinct from production.

api.evidence_quote: Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification and use standard HTTP response codes and verbs.
api.notes: No sandbox environment found — testing happens against production. Third-party (non-Brex-customer) buildability is limited without an existing Brex account.

verdict.rationale: Existing Brex admins can self-serve generate a Bearer token immediately, but there is no free sandbox and no account means no access.
